main_body: A vending machine: a grey-blue top panel, a pink front-edge line, then a magenta front face with an inset glass window, side buttons and a bottom slot.
top_band: Grey-blue L≈118-148 on rows 1-5, with a dark slot on row 3, then a pink L196 edge line on row 6
evidence: The column at x=8 reads as a lighter top band (rows 1-5, L 118-148), a pink front-edge line (row 6, L196), a dark eave row (row 7, L30), then the magenta front face (L≈69, rows 8-22) with an inset window. Step sizes are well above 25 L. The top band is only 5 rows and carries a dark slot that could be read as a sign panel, but it is clearly lighter than the face and ends in a distinct edge line, so the construction holds.

style.evidence: The candidate matches or beats the references on colour density: 22 colours per tile against 17 and 20, and 0% flat-fill coverage. Its dark edge pixels are 100% neutral (#181820, #08080c, #101016), against 1% and 33% for the references, so it has the uniform near-black sticker outline instead of dark material-tone outlines. The magenta body is mostly broad, simply stepped planes with little grain. The outline is the deciding weakness.
